notes.title: The day 1 patch
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.2

notes.title: Patch 0.4.0 - Holiday Update!
notes.content:
Patch 0.4.0 - Holiday Update!
New Features!
-Danger Levels! Harder difficulty modes for continued play after beating the game once! Currently, only danger level 1 is in-game, more to be added soon....
-Steam Achievements! Who doesn't like achievements?
-Holiday Elf Skin, Celebrate the holidays with a Santa hat for Elf!

Bug Fixes~!
-Fixed a bug where health stats weren't being added properly after restarting a run
-Fixed a bug with the shop selling the wrong items, or not selling any at all
-Fixed a bug where summon was not casting spells with proper damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309110/ac8c76032de6bcd3b5321c91f2cfa6335049d502.gif[/img]

Thank you all for supporting We Are Live, and have a happy holiday!

Ryan | Ventus Games

notes.title: Patch 0.3.6
notes.content:
Bug Fixes~!
-Game should now properly reset when you die by clicking the reset button
-Fixed an error with not being able to pick up artifacts
-Fixed a bunch of misc rooms that were supposed to give artifacts, but didn't
-Shop should now always have items in it

Thank you once again to those who found these bugs! Expect some more updates in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Patch 0.3.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Two new artifacts added: Heat Up, and Pyro Power.
[*] You can no longer find duplicate items in runs. (Except "Unknowns")
[*] Fixed issue with shop keeper dialogue in acts 2 and 3, also added unique shop dialogue depending on which companion you are using.
[*] New resolution options in the settings menu.
[*] Increased character limit on profile names to 16 (was 10).
[*] Fixed an issue with enemies not starting combat when approached from the front.
[*] Fixed bug with a certain encounter in the forest that stopped players from crafting spells.
[*] Fixed issues with characters that weren't Sei when leveling up.
[*] Fixed bug with vampire shot and heal damage that changed targeted enemies.
[*] Edited wording on summon node to improve clarity.
[*] Slowed down cast time on summon to improve clarity.
[*] Artifacts no longer overlay over combat transition, or tutorial tooltips.
[*] Can no longer put negative money into the bank.
[/list]

Thank you once again to everyone who helped me find these bugs!

Ryan | Ventus Games

notes.title: Patch 0.3.4
notes.content:
Patch 0.3.4
[list]
[*] Item Icons have been updated for consistency, some names have also been changed.
[*] Updated movement script to not be tied to machine frame rate.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a softlock when burn triggered on the Vine Lord and Sei was dead.
[*] Fixed a bug in act 3 where enemies didn't spawn in specifically if you were in room 5.
[*] Fixed Desync between player data when the heal pulse item was triggered.
[*] Altered dialogue to make consistency better.
[*] Fixed a small bug with spell icons not resetting after completing a run.
[/list]

Thank you to those who helped me find these bugs!

Ryan | Ventus Games

notes.title: We Are Live Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Thank you for checking out my game, and I'm excited to announce that the game is out in Steam Early Access right now!!

It's been a long road for me, and I'm excited to take the next step in the development journey by letting others experience the game! And with your help, it will become even better!

[b]A couple of notes about what is to come for We Are Live:[/b]

- I plan on pushing up sizeable content updates about once a month for the next couple of months. The first one should arrive sometime in December which will add controller support and maybe more...

- Other updates in the future will also contain new artifacts, areas, and more enemies! More details on this later...

- Expect some small updates frequently after release, as I learn more about balance, bugs I didn't find during testing, and QOL changes. I realized that if I don't release it and try to fix all the flaws it may never be released, which is why it's out now!

- Ventus Games is a really small team, and this is our first of hopefully many projects, so there may be some bugs. Keep that in mind as you play!

- The official soundtrack will be out soon, please give that a chance when it does come out! and [url=https://twitter.com/RichardSMusic_]follow RICHI on Twitter[/url]!


If you have any questions please reach out to me on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/GamesVentus]@GamesVentus[/url]) or on [url=https://discord.gg/b6JcHDRvFf]Discord[/url]! I'm happy to hear anything!


[b]Fan art![/b]
Every time I make one of these posts I'd like to feature fan art here. This one was made by my friend Liam, Check out his [url=https://twitter.com/MidnitePixel_]Twitter here[/url]! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309110/9a748cdc7eb66ca9ef4cb85bc5b5c9fe417344ed.png[/img]


Thank you for joining me on this journey, I hope you will enjoy We Are Live as much as I do!

Ryan | Ventus Games

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]A small overview[/h1]
Hello all!
I am completely astounded by the number of wishlists I have and I am excited to have people excited for We are Live. I can't wait to share it with you! So now it's time for a small update showing you what I've been working on!

Since the Next Fest, I Updated all the UI text to be high res instead of pixel art! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309110/8c09e75c8750dda877746783bfc3f213bb96de30.png[/img]

Programming is done for the second ally you can have, Vier! She focuses on defense over Sei's offense, and will surely mix up your runs when you choose her as a companion![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309110/9ab831e5747b38aa4930acdfe3478d32e6e74911.gif[/img]

I've also made significant progress in the second act of the game, a forest located outside repair station alpha. As always, I also got rid of bugs so so many bugs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309110/c90c1f87287b9f3608e2e392d79c93e53e240523.gif[/img]

Progress is continuing slowly, the release window will be a little bit later than originally planned however I am still aiming for a Q3 release later this year into early access. More info to come on that in a future dev update! I hope to do these once a month or so leading up to release, expect the next one in August!

[h1]Fan Art[/h1]
When I do development updates I would love to show off fan art from the community. This one is the very first, made by my sister. I can't wait to see more in the future!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309110/89c9bf06f26709fb03f893319afde10139d7e156.png[/img]
Sei looking particularly menacing.

[h1]Social Medias[/h1]
If you want sooner than monthly updates (or just want to chat) join the Discord or follow me on Twitter! I tend to post things weeky in both places, although they are much smaller in size. Thanks for reading and I hope you'll stick around!
-Ryan | Ventus Games
